item.text:
In this environment, `npm start` did not crash: it printed “listening” and exited immediately because [server.js](/private/tmp/envtest.GGiq8C/shop-api/src/server.js) never started a server.

I fixed it to listen on port 3000 and serve `/health`. I also removed startup logging that could expose configuration values. Verified that `npm start` stays running, `/health` returns HTTP 200, and an invalid `DATABASE_URL` exits with a safe error.
